Name: zstudio_state
Description: Read the visible workspace, document identities, revisions and current preview.

Name: zstudio_capabilities
Description: Read all capability schemas. Unsupported formats remain read-only; MCP does not add binary patching.

Name: zstudio_open_root
Description: Open and index a ZBD root in the visible workspace. Dirty documents must be explicitly saved or closed first. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_files
Description: List recognized files in the current root.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_search
Description: Search indexed assets without altering GUI selection; names are not identities.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_related
Description: List related indexed assets for an explicit asset, retaining source identities.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_asset_filter
Description: Set the Assets list query and kind filter without changing the selected record.

Name: zstudio_open_document
Description: Open or activate an archive and its visible preview. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_assets
Description: List assets by stable kind/index in an open document.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_select_asset
Description: Select an asset in the GUI and await its preview; does not retarget Properties. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_inspect_asset
Description: Read stored asset metadata and content. Animation edited state is returned separately from source.

Name: zstudio_source_bytes
Description: Read at most 4096 original source bytes; these are not pending edits or runtime memory.

Name: zstudio_close_document
Description: Close a document. Explicit discard=true is required for unsaved edits; pending drafts are never discarded implicitly.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: discard
Parameters.Description: Explicitly discard this document's accepted unsaved edits.

Name: zstudio_reload_document
Description: Reload a clean document from disk; dirty documents must first be saved or explicitly closed. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_undo_redo
Description: Undo or redo one accepted edit in the specified document.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_save_document
Description: Verified save: animations require a NEW destination outside the source root; pickups save owning archives or explicit new destinations. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: destinations
Parameters.Description: Pickup source archive path to new Save As path map.

AdditionalProperties.Description: New Save As path for this source archive.

Parameters.Name: backup
Parameters.Description: Pickup backup preference; defaults to app setting.

Name: zstudio_export
Description: Export assets through the existing deterministic exporter into a new folder outside the source tree. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: assets
Parameters.Description: Optional list of {kind,index}; omitted exports all.

Name: zstudio_validate
Description: Validate the source archive on disk, not pending edits. Returns structured diagnostics. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Name: zstudio_problems
Description: List file/operation problems with original severity and source context.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_operation
Description: Read operation status/result. Poll at sensible intervals; cancel is available only for export/validation.

Parameters.Name: cancel
Parameters.Description: Request cancellation of an export or validation.

Name: zstudio_texture_palette
Description: Read texture header and RGB565 palette entries.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_preview_state
Description: Read active preview options, camera and playback state.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_camera
Description: Read or set an upright camera pose, move relative to its viewing basis, rotate, or frame the active scene. Never captures the user's mouse.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: fov
Parameters.Description: Horizontal field of view in degrees.

Name: zstudio_scene_nodes
Description: List active assembled scene nodes by index, including instance metadata.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_scene_selection
Description: Select/inspect a scene node, isolate it, or show all nodes.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_scene_options
Description: Set static model/world options: lod(integer), difficulty(Easy/Medium/Hard), textures/wireframe/bounds/horizon(boolean), texturePack(path or empty for automatic). Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Properties.Name: texturePack
Properties.Description: Available texture pack path, or empty for automatic.

Name: zstudio_animation_options
Description: Set animation options: map/grid/collision/horizon/followCamera/effects/replay/mute/followLog(bool), height(-999..999), lod, difficulty, speed, volume, phase(runtime/cleanup), seed, condition(0/1/2), range/traceRange(seconds), autoRange/fitTrace(true), problemFilter(0..4), worldPath, root, activationOrigin/activationTarget(XYZ text or blank). Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: changes
Parameters.Description: Animation options; only supplied values change.

Properties.Name: activationOrigin
Properties.Description: Comma-separated XYZ, or blank for default.

Properties.Name: activationTarget
Properties.Description: Comma-separated XYZ, or blank for default.

Name: zstudio_animation_transport
Description: Play/pause/stop, frame-step or seek the current animation. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_animation_runtime
Description: Read preview status, sequence runtime, dispatched event occurrences, problems or bound scene nodes. Timing thresholds and observed dispatches remain distinct.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_animation_select
Description: Select an authored sequence/event without changing playback phase or retargeting Properties.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_texture_view
Description: Inspect or set texture presentation. Channels: 0 RGBA, 1 RGB, 2 Alpha, 3 Red, 4 Green, 5 Blue. Coordinates are texture pixels.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_sound_transport
Description: Control the selected sound preview and read waveform/cue metadata.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_capture
Description: Capture the current preview or a zStudio-owned window as PNG; never captures other applications. 3D images fit within width/height without distortion or resizing the viewport. Texture/window captures keep native dimensions.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state; required for target=preview.

Name: zstudio_workspace_view
Description: Read or set presentation preferences. Supports theme, density, preset, navigator/inspector/tools visibility, pane dimensions and tab indices. Does not commit drafts.

Properties.Name: navigatorWidth
Properties.Description: Preferred dimension in DIP; clamped to supported layout limits.

Properties.Name: inspectorWidth
Properties.Description: Preferred dimension in DIP; clamped to supported layout limits.

Properties.Name: toolsHeight
Properties.Description: Preferred dimension in DIP; clamped to supported layout limits.

Name: zstudio_window
Description: Read or change zStudio window state; close requires clean documents and resolved drafts.

Name: zstudio_properties_open
Description: Open the reusable Properties window for an explicit asset or animation sequence/event; current pending drafts must be resolved first.

Name: zstudio_properties_close
Description: Close the Properties window after drafts have been explicitly resolved.

Name: zstudio_properties_state
Description: Read the pinned Properties window identity, content and current editable fields.

Name: zstudio_scene_properties
Description: Inspect a scene node or open its Properties window, including editable mission pickups.

Parameters.Name: preview
Parameters.Description: Current preview lifetime ID from zstudio_state.

Name: zstudio_animation_records
Description: List authored sequence identities; supply sequence to page its events with full edited fields. Cleanup is listed separately from runtime sequences.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Optional sequence UUID for event details.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_references
Description: List authored reference table slots, including raw bytes and reserved/unverified status.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_event_catalog
Description: Describe supported event types, fields and preview limitations.

Name: zstudio_property_fields
Description: Read the same fields, choices, validation hints and actions as animation Properties, without opening or retargeting its window. IDs apply to this target/segment/revision.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Name: zstudio_property_edit
Description: Edit one Properties field using its current field ID and invariant editor text. Components use the delimiter shown in the current value. One undoable edit.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_property_action
Description: Run a currently available Properties action, including add/copy/delete/reorder keyframe segments.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_animation_structure
Description: Add, duplicate, delete or reorder authored sequences/events. Cleanup is not an extra runtime sequence.

Parameters.Name: sequence
Parameters.Description: Sequence GUID; omit for entry properties.

Parameters.Name: event
Parameters.Description: Event GUID; omit for sequence properties.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_reference_edit
Description: Retarget a verified stored reference name, preserving table indices. Reserved/unverified slots remain read-only.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_pickups
Description: Load/list all authored mission pickup placements and owning archive identities, including difficulty counterparts. Returns an operation ID; use zstudio_operation to await/read the result.

Parameters.Name: query
Parameters.Description: Case-insensitive name/path or displayed-text filter, applied before pagination.

Name: zstudio_pickup_lock
Description: Set this document's pickup editing lock; new documents are locked by default.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Name: zstudio_pickup_move
Description: Move a pickup to exact coordinates as one undoable operation, including unambiguous difficulty counterparts. Requires unlocked placements.

Parameters.Name: revision
Parameters.Description: Expected current document revision. Read before editing.

Parameters.Name: source
Parameters.Description: Exact source identity returned by pickups; field names are case-sensitive.

Properties.Name: ArchivePath
Properties.Description: Owning archive path returned by pickups.

Properties.Name: AssetIndex
Properties.Description: Resource asset index returned by pickups.

Properties.Name: RecordIndex
Properties.Description: Placement record index returned by pickups.

Name: zstudio_drafts
Description: Read pending GUI drafts and their conflict token without committing or changing focus.

Name: zstudio_resolve_drafts
Description: Explicitly apply or discard current GUI drafts. Invalid input is retained and returned as an error, without modal dialogs.
